# The class of every route the gateway mounts (legacy issue 6879).
#
# Format: <class> <METHOD> <chi pattern>. The class is one of:
#   inference  a model call. It can incur provider cost, so the analytics
#              pages count it as an LLM call.
#   other      not a model call: a listing, a token count, a credential check.
#
# Two tests read this file:
#   - internal/api/route_classes_test.go (this module) walks the chi router.
#     It fails when a mounted route is not in this file, or when this file
#     names a route that is not mounted. So a new route needs a class here.
#   - services/elitea-main/internal/domain/analytics/inference_routes_test.go
#     compares the "inference" patterns with analytics.InferenceRoutes(). So a
#     new inference route must also go into InferenceRouteSQLList, or its
#     calls disappear from the analytics pages.
#
# Do not move or rename this file without both tests.

inference POST /llm/v1/messages
other     POST /llm/v1/messages/count_tokens
other     POST /llm/v1/messages/*
inference POST /llm/v1/images/edits
inference POST /llm/v1/images/variations
inference POST /llm/v1/images/generations
inference POST /llm/v1/audio/speech
inference POST /llm/v1/audio/transcriptions
inference POST /llm/v1/audio/translations
inference POST /llm/v1/chat/completions
inference POST /llm/v1/completions
inference POST /llm/v1/embeddings
inference POST /llm/v1/responses
inference GET  /llm/v1/realtime
inference POST /llm/v1/realtime
other     GET  /llm/v1/models
other     GET  /llm/v1/models/*
other     POST /llm/v1/check_connection
other     POST /llm/v1/list_provider_models
other     POST /llm/v1/list_provider_voices
